title: Cloak of Displacement

sources.title: Displacement
markers: | description = At the beginning of the wearer's turn, the cloak activates, granting enemies {{Disadvantage}} on {{Attack Roll}}s that target the wearer. This effect lasts until the wearer takes damage.

summary: At the start of your turn, incoming attack rolls against you gain Disadvantage. The protection ends when you take damage.

fields.Effect: At the start of your turn, incoming attack rolls against you gain Disadvantage. The protection ends when you take damage.
